items.title: What Pursuit’s $485 Million Business Says About the Economics of Attractions
items.why: Per-guest yield at experiential operators matters when we assess experience-credit partner economics.
items.summary_ai: Pursuit's $485 million business is earning more per visitor, but reinvestment will determine how much cash remains.
